The Holly Bush

From Matt Molloy & Sean Keane’s “Contentment Is Wealth”. Also recorded as The Three Little Drummers on Chris Droney’s “Fertile Rock” and Tola Custy & Cyril O’Donoghue’s “Setting Free”. The version on Setting Free is as follows:

X: 1
T: The Three Little Drummers
T: Holly Bush, The
M: 6/8
L: 1/8
R: jig
K: Gmaj

BAG GDG|GDG ABc|~B3 edc|1 def g2d:|2 def g2f||

The Holly Bush - alternative A-part

I learned this alternative A-part from Clare concertina player Flo Fahy. She says she learned it from Chris Droney’s playing and names the tune Three Little Drummers. The extended range is easy on the concertina, maybe not-so-easy on other instruments. The B-part is the same as the other versions here.

BAG g2d|ge/f/g abc’|bag edc|B/c/dB cBA|
BAG g2d|ge/f/g abc’|bag edB|def g3:|

↳ Posted by jdicarlo on February 25th, 2021.

The Holly Bush, X:6

This setting based on Contentment is Wealth https://thesession.org/recordings/264 playing.
I first heard this jig on RTE on Ciarán Mac Mathúna’s gem of a programme on the radio on Sundays: Mo Cheol Thú. He had no name for the tune but said it was a version (or related to) Kitty’s Rambles. I agree with him. (His programme was followed by Sunday Miscellany, a wonderfully calm, unique programme, which I’m pleased to say still goes out on a Sunday at 9am)

↳ Posted by brailsford on March 17th, 2021.

The Holly Bush/ Kitty’s Rambles, X:7

This is version X6, dropped down to Dmix and the D of the second phrase flattened to C; the rest is octave switching, which some wind instrument players sometimes do. Apart from the jarring BAF phrase, it passes muster as Kitty’s Rambles.

↳ Posted by brailsford on March 17th, 2021.
